message:
Fix unresolved doc comment references (#193087)

Fixes doc comment references that the analyzer can't resolve, found by
temporarily enabling the `comment_references` lint.

Most are renames — the reference named a member that had been renamed,
made private, or removed. Four are judgement calls rather than renames,
so flagging them - happy to change any:

- `widgets/_window.dart` — removed a sentence describing the `if
(!isWindowingEnabled) { return widget.child; }` path deleted in
[#188866](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/188866). The `{@macro
flutter.widgets.windowing.experimental}` later in the same comment
already documents the windowing-disabled case.

- `widgets/_window.dart` — constructor doc repointed from the removed
`child` to `initialWindows`.

- `widgets/_window_win32.dart` — removed "This can be overridden via the
`[WindowingOwnerWin32.test]` constructor.". `git log -S
"WindowingOwnerWin32.test("` finds no commit that added that
constructor.

- `rendering/viewport.dart` — `[Viewport.slivers]` isn't a member;
`slivers` is a constructor parameter forwarded to `super(children:
slivers)`. We cannot reference another class's constructor parameter, so
this became `[Viewport]`'s `slivers`.

Towards https://github.com/flutter/flutter/issues/192870
